claim: Before adding to an established local chronicle, verify the canonical worktree, branch, base, and existing commit; if it already exists, reconcile and amend it instead of creating a duplicate worktree or record.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: Agnes had already created the requested chronicle in the suffixed canonical worktree. Confirming its branch, base, and commit avoided a duplicate worktree and duplicate memory record.
